title: a11y grid-read: clipboard bridge for owner-drawn grids
desc: MFC/GDI owner-drawn grids (HTS realtime tables) have no UIA/MSAA cell nodes. a11y grid-read focuses target, clears clipboard, sends Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C via SendInput, polls clipboard up to 2s, prints TSV verbatim. Override hotkey via --text.
steps: a11y grid-read <grap> -- runs default Ctrl+A,Ctrl+C chord
Custom chord via --text 'ctrl+shift+c' for apps with dedicated 'copy all' binding
Clipboard polled for up to 2s; TSV dumped to stdout on success
If empty clipboard after timeout the app did not honor the chord -- probe the right hotkey via the app's menu
100pct accuracy -- no OCR error, values come from the app's own copy path
Usage example: wkappbot a11y read '*Hero*/grid-area' returns only container; use wkappbot a11y grid-read '*Hero*/grid-area' for TSV cells
author: claude
